findings.problem: Service/cost outcomes are reported, but confirmation, misleading/missed-report and effect-versus-closure endpoints lack a complete separate readout and explicit missing-definition/not-evaluated reasons.
findings.important_boundary: Named-signal threshold confirmation is implemented by InspectionSession. It is not fault diagnosis or verified risk closure. Missing frozen opportunity/truth definitions must not become zero misses or false alarms.
findings.remedy: Freeze a saved-only descriptive completion plan, extract all existing runs without rerunning them, and retain explicit NA statuses for unoperationalized/unexecuted endpoints. Primary NO_PRACTICAL_GAIN and original denominator stay unchanged.

findings.requirement: R7 historical evidence timing and ticket24 review criteria
findings.problem: The historical dossier frame filters record IDs but retains current availability/age/provenance metadata. Previously valid review support can be incorrectly refused after expiry. Filtering to dossier IDs can also omit counterevidence available at review time.
findings.important_boundary: Current checks remain mandatory; this is not evidence of unsafe physical restoration. Registered31–35 explicitly have closure_program=None, so their measured primary outcomes do not invoke this branch.
findings.remedy: New bounded public-API engineering red/green evidence; rebuild review-time evidence through the existing ledger snapshot contract, count only dossier support while retaining review-time counterevidence, and preserve all current checks. New source version and prospective36 execution freeze are required; no old-source hash waiver or old-capture rewrite.
